"""Recorded rcb-limited/2.2 actions for bananas_in_bin_three_total.

This is an episode record, not a reset/replay script. The sequence used an open
Robotiq gripper throughout and pushed with the Panda forearm.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OPEN = 0.0
HIGH = np.array([.542, .095, .501, -.520, -.193, .301, .776, OPEN], dtype=np.float32)
LOW = np.array([.553, .092, .360, -.528620, -.187878, .302676, .770487, OPEN], dtype=np.float32)
PUSH_1 = np.array([.426, -.048, .309, -.666023, -.325838, .378373, .554145, OPEN], dtype=np.float32)
PUSH_2 = np.array([.426, -.048, .279, -.666023, -.325838, .378373, .554145, OPEN], dtype=np.float32)
PUSH_3 = np.array([.386, -.075, .279, -.666023, -.325838, .378373, .554145, OPEN], dtype=np.float32)


def run_recorded_sequence():
    robot = Robot()
    for pose, note in [
        (HIGH, "high staging"),
        (LOW, "lower forearm on positive-y side"),
        (PUSH_1, "forearm sweep toward bin"),
        (HIGH, "clear view"),
        (HIGH, "re-stage"),
        (LOW, "lower for contact"),
        (PUSH_2, "lower forearm sweep"),
        (HIGH, "retract"),
        (HIGH, "diagonal re-stage"),
        (LOW, "lower before diagonal sweep"),
        (PUSH_3, "diagonal forearm sweep"),
    ]:
        pose = pose.copy()
        pose[3:7] /= np.linalg.norm(pose[3:7])
        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", pose[None, :], video="none", note=note)
        if result.done:
            break


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_recorded_sequence()
